node.subject: english
node.title: 讨论社会热点
node.summary: 能用英语讨论社会热点
node.content_req: 在第四学段 (7~9 年级)教学情境中,能用英语讨论社会热点。
key_points: 能用英语讨论社会热点
在第四学段 (7~9 年级)教学情境中
能用英语围绕具体社会话题(如学生手机使用、AI写作业)阐明自己的观点并给出两条以上理由
能换到反对方立场,解释对方为何不赞成,而非只重复自己的观点
node.academic_req: 能在社会热点话题的英语讨论中,先阐明自己的立场并给出至少两条理由,再听懂并回应同伴的反驳,最后从对方角度补充或换位解释。
node.assessment_prompt: {{name}}抛出一个话题「中该不该有自己的手机」,能不能用英语说出至少两个理由,站正方或反方都行?\n同桌用英语反驳说「but phones distract us from homework」,{{name}}能不能听懂并用英语接一句回应,比如承认对方有道理或者再补一个反例?\n如果{{name}}追问「说大部分赞成,但有没有人不赞成的?为什么?」,能不能换角度解释一下反对方的考虑,而不是只会重复自己的观点?
node.title_pinyin: tao lun she hui re dian
node.description: 拿最近的热门话题当口语练习场——「双减」好不好、该不该让小学生用 AI 写作业、外卖骑手该不该闯红灯,孩子能用英语说出自己的看法,还能听懂同桌的反驳并接话。不是背稿演讲,是像课间闲聊那样你来我往。

node.teaching_activity: 用 4 张社会热点图片卡（手机使用、垃圾分类、网课利弊、偶像崇拜）每组抽 1 张，计时 2 分钟小组讨论 3 个问题（What? Why? How?），再请 2 组孩子上台脱稿汇报；教师在黑板写 5 个高频句型支撑（I think... /
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,口语课就是课间那种'你来我往'的争论。比如'该不该让小学生用 AI 写作业',你先说一句 'I think it harms their thinking',同桌反驳 'But it saves time',你再接 'Even so, they won't learn to solve problems'。记住,先亮观点,再给两条理由,再试着替对方说话。

exercises.question: In a class debate on "Should primary school students use AI to do homework?", your classmate says: "I think it's fine because it saves time." Which reply best shows you understand the other side before giving your own view?
exercises.explanation: C 先承认对方立场 (saving time) 再给出自己的理由 (won't learn to think), 符合「先亮观点+给理由+替对方说话」的要求。A 和 B 直接否定对方, D 只是附和, 都没体现讨论中的你来我往。
options: A. "I don't agree. AI is bad."
B. "You're totally wrong and you know nothing about studying."
C. "I see your point about saving time, but if kids rely on AI, they won't learn to think by themselves."
D. "AI is cool, so everyone should use it for homework."

exercises.question:
Read the dialogue and choose the best response to fill in the blank.

A: What do you think of the "double reduction" policy (双减政策)? It reduces students' homework and off-campus tutoring.
B: _____________________. I think it helps kids have more time to rest and develop hobbies.
exercises.explanation: 空处需填入一个与后文观点一致的回应。后文表达支持「双减」政策,认为它能让孩子有更多时间休息和发展兴趣爱好,因此选 A "I agree with you"。B "I disagree" 与后文态度矛盾;C "I don't mind it" 立场模糊;D "I'm not sure" 不表达支持,均不符合语境。本题考查在讨论社会热点话题时如何根据上下文选择恰当的回应表达。
options: D. I'm not sure about it
exercises._original_question: Complete the dialogue about "双减"(homework reduction policy). Use the given first letters as hints.
exercises._auto_fix_note: 题目带四个选项及 A-D 答案，改为选择题以匹配交互和评分器。

exercises.question: 话题: "Should delivery riders be allowed to run red lights if they are in a hurry?" 请用英语说出你的观点, 并给出至少两条理由, 再试着替反对方说一句话。
exercises.answer: I think delivery riders should NOT run red lights. First, it's against traffic rules and puts themselves and others in danger. Second, if they cause an accident, they may lose money instead of earning more. I understand why some people disagree: they say riders earn little and need to deliver on time, so they feel they have no choice.
exercises.explanation: 评分要点: 1. 是否清晰亮出观点 (agree/disagree); 2. 是否给出两条以上相关理由 (安全/规则/后果等); 3. 是否换到反对方立场说一句, 而非只重复自己观点。三项都做到即为合格口语表达。

exercises.question: 你班上的英国交换生 Tom 对中国的"双减"政策很感兴趣,在课间聊天时他问你:"Do you think the 'Double Reduction' policy is good or bad?" 请你用英语给出自己的观点(支持或反对均可),并至少说出两条理由。字数 50-80 词。
exercises.answer: I think the Double Reduction policy is good. First, it reduces too much homework, so we have more time to rest and play sports. Second, it cuts off expensive tutoring classes, which is fairer for students from poorer families. However, I also understand some parents worry that without extra classes, their kids may fall behind. (68 words)
exercises.explanation: 1. 审题: 观点+两条理由,围绕"双减"政策;2. 关键点:先亮观点(I think it is good),再给两条独立理由(reduces homework / fairer for poor families),可加让步以体现对话感;3. 语言:用 First, Second 衔接,句式正确,理由具体而非空话。

exercises.question: 同桌 Lily 说:"I think primary school students should be allowed to use AI to do homework, because it helps them finish tasks faster and learn from the answers." 你不完全同意。请你:(1) 明确说出你自己的观点;(2) 给出至少两条理由;(3) 换到 Lily 的立场,用一句话解释她为什么那样想,而不要只重复自己的观点。字数 80-120 词。
exercises.answer: (1) I don't think primary school students should use AI to do homework. (2) First, if AI does the work for them, they won't learn to think by themselves, and their problem-solving skills will get weaker. Second, they may become lazy and rely on it every day, which is a bad habit at a young age. Also, teachers can't know what students really understand. (3) I understand Lily thinks it saves time and gives them model answers to learn from, so she sees AI as a helpful tutor, not a cheat. (95 words)
exercises.explanation: 1. 观点清晰:用 I don't think... 明确反对;2. 两条理由独立且具体(不会独立思考/养成依赖坏习惯);3. 换位思考:准确说出 Lily 的逻辑(saves time, model answers, helpful tutor)而非简单否定,体现"替对方说话";4. 语言流畅,衔接自然。
